programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh hosts a double-date pizza party on the farm and takes the Italian grilling outside  she makes cheesy fried risotto balls, grilled zucchini pizza with basil mint pesto and a crisp Romaine salad drizzled in bacon fat vinaigrette.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh is making a Mexican food vacation for her husband, Nick, with all his favorites  she cooks up a decadent refried beans and rice bowl, roasted salmon tacos in flour tortillas and creamy coconut-lime tres leches cake.

programs.title: Midnight Misadventures With Mallika Dua
programs.desc: Shalishka taps into her talents during a game of Ultimate Music Champion with artist Vishal Dadlani  they later make deviled eggs with noodle salad.
